firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently saw a zombie movie starts.
officialTieBreak: If there is a tie, the tied players roll a die; the highest roll goes first.
clarifications: After a turn, play proceeds clockwise. The booklet also includes cooperative and scenario modes.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 2 gives the zombie-movie criterion and explicit die-roll tie break. Page 12 gives clockwise turns, and page 10 credits Twilight Creations ©2014. Map tiles, zombies, heart and bullet tokens match inventory BGG 2471. SHA-256: bd7d71f2ed4c69fb22b0082cecc6884785235f480f7e149b43231e2dc6a6cd1f. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: The booklet does not address tied highest die rolls; roll again is not stated.
